We operate a platform that enables regenerative communities to manage accommodations, bookings, events, subscriptions, governance, and community resources. privacy_policy_section_1_agreement: By accessing or using {platformName}, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this policy, please do not access the platform.
privacy_policy_section_2_1_intro: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when using our services, including:

privacy_policy_section_2_3_item_3: Usage data (pages visited, features used, time spent)
privacy_policy_section_3_intro: We use collected information for the following purposes:
privacy_policy_section_3_1_item_4: Facilitating volunteer coordination and task management
privacy_policy_section_3_3_item_1: Analyzing usage patterns to improve services
privacy_policy_section_3_3_item_3: Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security
privacy_policy_section_4_intro: We may share your information in the following circumstances:
privacy_policy_section_4_1_text: Communities using {platformName} receive access to member data necessary for operating their services. Each community may have additional privacy practices, and we encourage you to review their specific policies.
privacy_policy_section_4_2_intro: We share information with third-party service providers who assist in:
privacy_policy_section_4_2_item_1: Payment processing (Stripe and other payment providers)
privacy_policy_section_4_3_text: When using token-based features, certain information is recorded on public blockchain networks (such as Celo). This includes wallet addresses and transaction records, which are publicly visible and immutable by design. We do not control blockchain networks and cannot delete on-chain data.
privacy_policy_section_4_4_text: We may disclose information when required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or when we believe disclosure is necessary to protect our rights, your safety, or the safety of others.
privacy_policy_section_5_intro: We retain personal information for as long as necessary to:
privacy_policy_section_5_item_1: Provide our services and maintain your account
privacy_policy_section_5_item_2: Comply with legal obligations (including tax and financial reporting)
privacy_policy_section_5_text: Your data is retained in perpetuity unless you choose to delete it. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time through your account settings in the platform UI, or via our API. Governance and voting records recorded on-chain cannot be deleted due to the immutable nature of blockchain technology.
privacy_policy_section_6_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
privacy_policy_section_6_access_text: Request a copy of personal information we hold about you
privacy_policy_section_6_correction_text: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy_policy_section_6_deletion_text: Request deletion of your personal information (subject to legal retention requirements)
privacy_policy_section_6_portability_tex: Request your data in a portable format
privacy_policy_section_6_objection_text: Object to certain processing of your data
privacy_policy_section_6_withdraw_text: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
privacy_policy_section_6_text: You can exercise most of these rights directly through your account settings, including Privacy controls for Near you, and deleting all your data. For additional requests, contact us at {teamEmail}. Note that on-chain blockchain data cannot be modified or deleted.
privacy_policy_section_7_intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
privacy_policy_section_7_text: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.
privacy_policy_section_8_text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including encryption, access controls, and regular security assessments. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy_policy_section_9_text_1: Our servers are currently located in Germany within the European Union. Your information may also be processed by third-party service providers in other jurisdictions, including the United States. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
privacy_policy_section_9_text_2: In the future, {platformName} intends to deploy its own cloud infrastructure hosted by the regenerative communities themselves, further decentralizing data storage and aligning with our values of community sovereignty.
privacy_policy_section_10_text: Our services are not directed to individuals under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child, we will take steps to delete such information.
privacy_policy_section_11_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. affiliate_landing_rule_tracking: If your tracking link was not used, we cannot attribute the referral or pay commission on it.
affiliate_landing_rule_spam: No spamming, cookie stuffing or misleading promotions.
affiliate_landing_rule_disclose: Be transparent — disclose your affiliate relationship wherever it is required.
affiliate_landing_rule_brand: Respect the {platform} brand and values in your promotions, and use the assets we provide.
affiliate_landing_rule_bidding: Do not bid on the {platform} name, or close variations and misspellings of it, in paid search or social campaigns without written permission.
affiliate_landing_rule_reselling: Do not resell our products — your audience books and buys on our site themselves.
affiliate_landing_rule_coupons: Do not promote discounts or coupon codes that do not exist or have expired.
affiliate_landing_rule_breach: If any of the above happens, we may deactivate your affiliate account without prior warning, and pending commissions may go unpaid.

residency_exit_note: You're free to end your season at any time, without penalty. As a courtesy to the community, we ask for {weeks} weeks' notice where possible, so meals, rooms and land work can be planned.
residency_stay_covered_intro: So that volunteering costs you nothing, the Association provides accommodation, meals and utilities for the whole season, free of charge. This is program support under {law}, not payment.
residency_checking_rooms: Checking which rooms are free for these dates…
residency_room_taken_note: {accommodation} is already taken for {days} of the {total} days you selected. Pick another room above, or move your arrival and departure.
residency_tokens_not_earned: {symbol} can be spent on stays and upgrades. The allocation is discretionary and is never calculated from the hours you give.
residency_upgrade_fiat_due: Still owed in euros for the upgrade: {amount}
residency_slip_know_body: You may end your season at any time, giving {weeks} weeks' notice where possible. If you're not covered by mandatory social security, you can enroll in the seguro social voluntário — we'll help with the paperwork. Your activities are described in your Volunteer Program (Annex I) and complement, never replace, the work of the paid team.
residency_slip_generates: Generates: Volunteer Agreement (Acordo de Voluntariado) · version {version} · {law} · EN + PT
residency_missing_association_name: Association — the organisation promoting the volunteer program, named on every agreement.
residency_missing_legal_framework: Legal framework — the volunteering law the program runs under, e.g. "Lei n.º 71/98".
residency_missing_notice_weeks: Notice — the courtesy notice asked for before someone ends their season.
residency_distribution_explainer: {monthly} {symbol} for each of your {months} months, allocated by the association to those who spend a season here. {symbol} has no liquid market, so its fair market value is {value} — this is a share in the commons, not payment for your time.
residency_missing_food_monthly: Food — no default food option is priced, so what the program spends feeding a volunteer is unknown. Set one under Food.
residency_missing_utilities_monthly: Utilities — the booking config has no utility rate, so what the program spends on power and water is unknown.
residency_missing_token_price: Token price — it could not be read off the bonding curve, so the allocation cannot be sized.
residencies_intro_host: Every season signed here. Approve one to countersign it on behalf of the association, or end it — either side may stop at any time, and nothing is charged on the way out.
residencies_intro_volunteer: The volunteer seasons you have signed. You can end one yourself any time before it starts; once it is under way, your coordinator ends it with you.
residencies_login_required: Sign in to see your volunteer seasons.
residencies_owed: {amount} still to settle for the room upgrade.
residencies_cancel_locked: Under way — ask your coordinator to end it.
residencies_cancel_confirm_body: {role} · {season}. Nothing is charged and nothing is clawed back, and the room is released for someone else. This cannot be undone — a new season would have to be signed.
residencies_cancel_reason_label: Anything you want to tell the coordinator? (optional)
residencies_cancel_reason_placeholder: In your own words — this goes to the coordinator, not on a record.
residency_missing_expense_reimbursement_: Expense reimbursement window — days within which documented expenses are reimbursed. Read by the API when a season is filed.
residency_missing_sweat_rate: Seniority per $Sweat — how the association's budget for a role grows with $Sweat held. Set 0 to size the allocation from the role's budget alone.
residency_missing_sweat_max_bonus: Seniority bonus cap — the ceiling on that growth. Set 0 for none.
residencies_tokens_to_stake: {amount} {symbol} to stake against the room upgrade.
residencies_room_settled: Room settled — nothing more is owed on this season.
residencies_room_unsettled: Room confirmed. Still to settle before the booking reads paid: {owed}.
residencies_approved_paid: Countersigned. The room is confirmed and nothing is owed.
residencies_approved_owed: Countersigned. The room is confirmed; the volunteer still has {owed} to settle through their booking before it reads paid.
residencies_approved_self_housed: Countersigned. No room was reserved — the volunteer houses themselves.
stay_residency_locked: This room is held by a volunteer season. Its dates and room are set by the agreement, so they cannot be changed here — to take a different room or different dates, end the season and sign a new one.
community_near_you_share_prompt: Meet people from the community who live near you.
community_near_you_share_body: Share your location to discover members nearby. We only show your city and an approximate distance — never your exact coordinates.
community_near_you_empty: No members nearby yet. Check back as more people share their location.
community_near_you_unavailable: Nearby members are temporarily unavailable. You can still share your location so we can match you later.
community_near_you_location_error: Could not read your location. Check browser permissions and try again.
settings_privacy_nearby_label: Show Near you on the community page
settings_privacy_nearby_help: When off, the Near you section is hidden and you will not appear in other members’ nearby results. Sharing precise location is always opt-in.
privacy_policy_section_2_4_intro: If you opt in to the Near you feature, we may collect:
privacy_policy_section_2_4_item_1: Precise device location from your browser or device, only after you choose to share it
privacy_policy_section_2_4_item_2: A derived city or place name associated with that location
privacy_policy_section_2_4_item_3: Your preference for participating in Near you, which you can change in account settings
privacy_policy_section_3_1_item_6: Showing nearby community members when you opt in to share your location (city and approximate distance only)
privacy_policy_section_4_2_item_6: Geocoding or reverse-geocoding services used to derive a city or place name from a location you share
privacy_policy_section_4_5_text: If Near you is enabled and you have shared your location, other signed-in members may see your display name, profile photo, city or place name, and approximate distance from them. We do not share your exact coordinates with other members. You can turn Near you off at any time in Settings → Privacy; when off, the feature is hidden for you and you are excluded from nearby results for others.
